[[File:Comminterlink.jpg|300px|thumb|Sparky repairing the comm interlink on Artorias.]]
A '''communication station''', also referred to as '''comm interlink''', '''comm node''',<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> or '''comm booth'''<ref name="TTDJ">{{JournalCite|10|Toria Tell's Droid Journal (article)}}</ref> was the public version of a [[Comm unit/Legends|comm unit]] &mdash; an electronic device that handled communications between planets.

==History==
[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Darsha Assant]], [[Lorn Pavan]] and [[I-5YQ]] tried to find a working comm station in the [[Crimson Corridor|high-crime district]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

One such unit was stationed at the [[Artorias communications center]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. Since it was damaged, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] named [[Sparky (Human)|Sparky]] was assigned the task of fixing the interlink but was unsuccessful. He desperately sought the assistance of [[Dulac]] who pretended to fix it, but did nothing since he was an advance agent of a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] fleet.

While tampering with the machine, the agent received a transmission from the crew of the ''[[Pythea]]'' warning of the impending invasion. However, he ensured the information was not released. During the [[Battle of Artorias|Yuuzhan Vong invasion]], the comm station was left offline; preventing communications between the planet and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Given their hatred of mechanical technology, the machine was presumably destroyed by the Yuuzhan Vong during their occupation.
